<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+2 peak at ~33% of the base peak, which matches the characteristic isotopic pattern of chlorine (Cl‑35/Cl‑37 ratio ~3:1). No other element exhibits such a definitive pattern in the data. Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
